subject: Mythology
title: What Was the Celtic World?
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Was the Celtic World?.

hook.text: The Celts once ruled from Ireland to Turkey, yet they left almost no written records of their own beliefs.

buildup.text: Their mythology survived through oral tradition, passed down by druids who memorized vast stores of knowledge.

discovery.text: Irish monks later wrote down the old pagan stories, mixing them with Christian elements to preserve them.

twist.text: Because of this, Celtic myths exist in fragmented layers: pagan originals filtered through Christian scribes.

climax.text: Despite the gaps, enough survived to reveal one of the richest mythologies in all of Europe.

punchline.text: A mythology that was never written down still refused to die.

quiz.question: How did Celtic myths survive without written records?
options: They were carved into stone monuments across Europe
Druids memorized them, and later monks wrote them down
Roman soldiers recorded them in military reports
